- Catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roblambert9/signal-desk/main/agents/catalog.json
- Foundry intake: https://github.com/roblambert9/signal-desk/issues/1

Teaser is free. Production use of the feed requires sku agent-license $49/mo. Comment a license key on issue #1.
